summary.text: Buzz Scherr is the incumbent Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Rockingham 26, in the November 3, 2026 general election. He has represented the district since December 2024, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Scherr earned a bachelor's degree from Yale University and a law degree from Vermont Law School.
His career experience includes working as a police commissioner.
He won the 2024 general election for the seat with 99.5 percent of the vote and advanced from the September 8, 2026 Democratic primary unopposed.
